subject: general
question: In quadrilateral PQRS, the bisectors of ∠R and ∠S meet at the point T (inside the quadrilateral) and ∠STR = 28°. If the ratio of ∠P to ∠Q is 3 : 4, then what is the difference between the measures of ∠Q and ∠P?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Property: Angle between bisectors of adjacent angles = (Sum of other two angles) / 2

⇒ ∠STR = (∠P + ∠Q) / 2

⇒ 28° = (∠P + ∠Q) / 2 ⇒ ∠P + ∠Q = 56°

Ratio ∠P : ∠Q = 3 : 4 ⇒ Total 7 units = 56° (1 unit = 8°)

Difference = 4 − 3 = 1 unit = 8°

**∴ Answer = 8°**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Quadrilateral PQRS, ∠STR = 28°, ∠P : ∠Q = 3 : 4. ST and RT are angle bisectors.

**Formula used:**

Sum of angles in a triangle = 180° | Sum of angles in a quadrilateral = 360°

 
 
• 
• P Q R S T (28°) Bisector ST Bisector RT ∠STR = 28° 

**Calculations:**

In ΔSTR, ∠TSR + ∠TRS + ∠STR = 180°

⇒ (∠S / 2) + (∠R / 2) + 28° = 180°

⇒ (∠R + ∠S) / 2 = 180° − 28° = 152°

⇒ ∠R + ∠S = 152° × 2 = 304°

⇒ In quad PQRS, ∠P + ∠Q + ∠R + ∠S = 360°

⇒ ∠P + ∠Q + 304° = 360°

⇒ ∠P + ∠Q = 56°

⇒ Let ∠P = 3x and ∠Q = 4x, then 3x + 4x = 56°

⇒ 7x = 56° ⇒ x = 8°

⇒ Difference = 4x − 3x = x = 8°

**∴ The correct answer is 8° (Option 3).**
